run_GAR_urltitle_generator: run the GAR URL title generator script with a test data file and output filename via argparse CLI
create_load_data: create a function that loads JSONL data from a file and returns a list of parsed JSON records
create_store_data: create a function that stores a list of JSON objects as newline-delimited JSON to a file
run_main_pipeline: run the main pipeline that loads GENRE model, samples title predictions in batches, and writes enriched output
test_load_data: test the load_data function with a JSONL file containing valid JSON records
